newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, short covering aids nearbys.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, short covering aids nearbys.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed, with nearbys gaining on short covering tied to signs the market was short-term oversold, traders said.
"This was basically a short covering rally after five consecutive lower closes," a trader said. "But the late weakness tells you that the trend remains downward."

KCBT wheat remained firm relative to CBOT wheat, which closed lower after delivery notices of 1.15 million bushels were posted Wednesday against the December contract. No deliveries were posted on KCBT wheat Wednesday.

KCBT wheat settled seven cents per bushel lower to 3/4 cents higher, with Dec up 1/2 cent at $4.36 a bushel. March also gained 1/2 cent to close 1/2 cent higher at $3.89. Volumes were very sluggish, traders said.

New-crop July set a new contract low of $3.37-1/2 per bushel on continued good crop condition reports for U.S. HRW wheat. Cash wheat basis bids in Kansas City were steady to two cents lower, lending pressure to KCBT wheat futures.
Traders said Benson-Quinn bought 1.1 million March bushels, Refco bought 1.6 million March and General Mills bought 600,000 March. CIS sold 1.1 million March.
